basis: si_mem_available includes active and inactive file LRUs, retaining min(half of page cache, low watermark).
project_policy: Credit floor(half of clean file LRU bytes), limited by usage, non-shmem file, host MemAvailable and each finite cgroup ancestor. No slab, anonymous, unevictable or swap credit.
not_equivalent_to_kernel: cgroup estimate is deliberately more conservative for file credit and does not claim globally identical MemAvailable arithmetic.
